title: Antico West E-commerce Website
summary: An E-commerce website for a business that sells engineering tools, welding machines, lubricants, safety equipment etc.
body:
## What it does

AnticoWest is an e-commerce website where customers can purchase engineering equipment, agriculture equipment ,technical equipment, etc.

## My contribution

I built several pages by hand with HTML and CSS, without a framework, to get a solid understanding of layout before moving to React. The layouts use Flexbox, and a media query adapts them for phones. Vanilla JavaScript powers the mobile menu, which opens and closes on small screens, and the product gallery, where clicking a thumbnail swaps the main image. 

## What I learned

Structuring a multi-page site taught me how much repeated code (the header, footer and product cards) plain HTML creates, and why component-based tools like React exist. It also showed me the gap between a storefront that looks complete and one that works: the cart and forms need JavaScript state or a backend behind them.
